category_edits.rationale: Jointly shorten maximum history from 64 to 48 and lower learning rate from 6e-4 to 5.5e-4 across all four category models. Shorter sequences reduce convolution cost while covering most observed histories; the slightly smaller learning rate may stabilize optimization. Existing metadata and predictor construction propagate the new maximum length consistently. All other hyperparameters, model formulas, seeds, routing and training limits remain unchanged.

change_summary: Tune NextItNet history length to 48 and learning rate to 5.5e-4, preserving one independent checkpoint per category and metadata-driven predictor compatibility.
